column1: # T17: resolutions of the DISPLAY name conflicts between names_display.tsv and names_display.T11{b..g}.tsv
# Rule: the sub-task that owns the subsystem page wins (T11b mainlink, T11c update, T11d SPI, T11e GUI, T11f input,
# T11g GPIO/RTC/files), and a name family already used by the owner is kept together.

column3: T11g owner; loser gpio_rx_update (T11c, the names were swapped)
T11f (the 48-byte block holds 6 doubles of touch calibration); loser flashcfg_load (T11g)
T11g owner (MemList/Menu .dat files, sdmenu_* family); loser sfl_write_file (T11c)
T11b owner (the ring logs MAIN-link frames); loser dbglog_toggle (T11f)
T11d owner (pclink_* family with pclink_stats_print); losers sdr_testmode_set (T11e), spi_slave_test_enable (T11f)
T11g: describes the whole sequence (FS off, LCD off, MAIN reset pulse, WDT reset); losers mainlink_fail_reset (T11b), update_finish_reset (T11c), system_reset_all (T11f)
T11b owner (SCIF4 link object; SCIF4 is never started in V01-08); loser dsp_queue_frame (T11f)
T11b rename (it replays a frame locally, it does not transmit); loser mainlink_send_cmd (T06)
T11e owner (GUI, scr_* family); loser gui_screensaver_step (T11b)
T11e fix (it is the "SCREEN SHOT" popup); loser screen_shot_menu (T06)
T11e fix (fills with 0 = transparent); loser fb_copy_rect (T06)
T11b rename (it replays SEND_CMD.TXT); losers debug_recv_cmd_log (T06), test_disp_replay (T11e)
T11d: base 0xE8200400 is DMAC channel 8 (ch0-7 at 0xE8200000 + 0x40*n, ch8-15 at 0xE8200400 + 0x40*(n-8)); loser dmac0_copy (T11e)
T11c owner (fwdbg_* family with fwdbg_task_create); losers display_flash_verify_bank1 (T11f), display_flash_write_bank (T06)
